mediaItems.summaryNotes: Explores how NYPD quotas directly lead to wrongful arrests and prosecutions, particularly in minority communities. The documentary provides significant insight into the systemic issue of policing quotas and their consequences. It follows active-duty NYPD officers who risked their careers to expose the practice through a class-action lawsuit.
